bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Depleted Zambia midfield faces Burundi's compact block in Ndola.

spf.comment: Covers both a 1:1 stalemate and a 0:1 counter-attacking ambush, as a single away-win call would ignore Zambia's home crowd and Fashion Sakala's remaining threat.

over_under.comment: Adjusted goal expectancy drops below 2.3 goals with Zambia missing four key forwards and Burundi prioritizing a compact defensive block.

score.comment: 1:1 leads the Poisson matrix and reflects shared vulnerabilities, while 0:1 captures Burundi punishing late home over-extension.

goals.comment: Two goals is the modal Poisson outcome at 24.2%, while one goal rises sharply given Zambia's attacking absences.

bqc.comment: A cagey, level first half against Burundi's deep block splits into either a shared second-half draw or a late away counter.
